name: TPMS Service Kit - Set of 4
shortDescription: Rebuild and reset four TPMS sensors
longDescription: Replace TPMS service kits (valve core, grommet, nut, cap) on all four sensors, test sensor transmission, relearn sensor positions to the vehicle.

name: TPMS Sensor Replacement - Single
longDescription: Dismount tire, replace one failed TPMS sensor, remount and balance, program sensor id to the vehicle, verify transmission and clear the TPMS lamp.

name: Tire Repair - Patch and Plug
longDescription: Dismount tire, inspect the casing interior for run-flat damage, buff and apply a combination patch-plug unit to a repairable tread-area puncture, remount, balance and torque to spec.

name: Road Force Balance - Set of 4
shortDescription: Road force variation balance, four wheels
longDescription: Measure road force variation on all four assemblies, match-mount tire to rim high point where variation exceeds tolerance, rebalance and record before/after readings.

name: Lug Torque Re-check
longDescription: Re-torque all wheel fasteners to manufacturer specification with a calibrated torque wrench, inspect for seating and stud damage, record the reading.

name: Tire Installation - Light Truck Set of 4
shortDescription: Mount and balance four LT tires
longDescription: Mount and balance four light-truck tires including heavier assemblies and higher inflation pressures, install valve stems, reset TPMS, torque to LT specification.

name: Tire Installation - Commercial Single
longDescription: Mount one commercial truck tire on a steel or aluminium rim using a commercial changer, inspect the rim and lock ring, inflate in a safety cage, torque to commercial specification.

name: Nitrogen Inflation - Set of 4
shortDescription: Purge and fill four tires with nitrogen
longDescription: Purge ambient air from all four tires, fill with nitrogen to specification, verify purity, fit nitrogen valve caps.

name: Michelin Casing Inspection
longDescription: Inspect a Michelin casing against the manufacturer retreadability criteria: bead condition, sidewall separations, repair history, shoulder wear and DOT age; record the disposition for the casing credit programme.

name: Michelin Retread Evaluation
shortDescription: Evaluate a casing for the retread programme
longDescription: Shearography and visual evaluation of a Michelin casing for the retread programme, document findings and photograph defects, submit the evaluation record.

name: Fleet PM - A Service
longDescription: Fleet A-interval preventive maintenance: oil and filter, chassis lubrication, fluid levels, lamp and wiper check, tyre pressures and tread depths recorded to the fleet log.

name: Fleet PM - B Service
longDescription: Fleet B-interval preventive maintenance: everything in the A service plus brake measurement, suspension and steering inspection, exhaust inspection, battery load test and a road test.

name: DOT Annual Inspection
longDescription: Federal annual inspection to 49 CFR 396 Appendix A: brakes, coupling devices, exhaust, fuel system, lighting, steering, suspension, frame, tyres, wheels and rims; complete and file the inspection report.

name: Fleet Tread Depth Audit
shortDescription: Record tread depths across a unit
longDescription: Measure and record tread depth at three points across every tyre on the unit, note irregular wear patterns and pressures, and file the audit against the fleet account.

name: Tire Installation - Set of 4
longDescription: Mount and balance complete set of four tires, install valve stems, torque lug nuts, reset TPMS sensors.

name: Wheel Balance - Set of 4
longDescription: Computer spin balance all four wheels, add or remove balance weights, re-install, verify no steering wheel vibration.

name: Tire Rotation
longDescription: Four-tire rotation following manufacturer recommended pattern including torque to spec, inspection for wear, tread depth measurement, and tire pressure adjustment.
